Oil & Gas ERP Software for Malaysia: Built for Oilfield Services, PETRONAS Compliance, and Wellsite Inspection

Malaysian oilfield service companies operate in one of the most compliance-intensive markets in Southeast Asia. PETRONAS licensing and PTS technical standards govern who works and how; DOSH regulates pressure equipment and site safety; and clients from Kuala Lumpur head offices to Labuan supply bases and Miri operations expect documentation at operator standard. Generic ERP systems know none of this. Atlantis ERP is an affordable, fully customizable ERP built on 30+ Odoo apps by inspection professionals — designed for oilfield services, inspection, and NDT companies that live between the wellsite and the audit.

PETRONAS Licensing and PTS Compliance Support

Winning and keeping PETRONAS-licensed work means demonstrating competent personnel, calibrated equipment, and procedures aligned to PETRONAS Technical Standards. Atlantis ERP structures that evidence: personnel competency and certification matrices, procedure and document control with revision history, equipment registers with calibration status, and job records that tie all three to every work order. When a PETRONAS or operator audit lands, your compliance package is generated from live data — not reconstructed from email threads.

DOSH and Regulatory Requirements

DOSH requirements around certificated pressure equipment (PMT/PMA), competent persons, and occupational safety add another documentation layer. Atlantis ERP tracks statutory inspection dates, certificates, and competent-person assignments alongside commercial records, with expiry alerts before lapses become findings. For inspection contractors, technician qualifications under SNT-TC-1A and ISO 9712 are native via the certification tracking module.

Wellsite Inspection Workflows

Drill pipe and BHA inspection, OCTG inspection, lifting gear surveys, pressure testing, and wellsite NDT each need method-specific reports, serialized component traceability, and rapid turnaround. Atlantis ERP runs these as structured workflows: serialized items in, inspection results captured on tablets in the yard or at the wellsite, certificates generated per DS-1, API RP 7G-2, or client specification, and results archived against each asset's history. See our NDT reporting software comparison framework for what field-grade reporting requires.

Equipment Mobilization and Logistics

Oilfield service margins are made and lost in mobilization. Atlantis ERP manages equipment packages: container manifests, calibration and certification validity checks before load-out, offshore/onshore tracking, and demobilization inspection on return. Kit that cannot legally go offshore — lapsed calibration, missing certs — is flagged before it reaches the quayside, protecting both revenue and reputation.

Kuala Lumpur, Labuan, and Miri Operations in One System

Most Malaysian service companies run a KL commercial office with operational bases in Labuan, Miri, Kemaman, or Kerteh. Atlantis ERP is multi-branch by design: shared clients and contracts, base-level inventory and dispatch, consolidated finance, and management dashboards spanning all locations. Crews and equipment move between bases without records fragmenting.

Quote-to-Cash for Oilfield Service Companies

From ITB response through call-out order, service ticket, timesheet, and invoice, Atlantis ERP keeps commercial flow in one thread. Day rates, offshore premiums, standby, mobilization charges, and third-party recharges carry from quote to invoice automatically; field tickets signed on site become invoice lines without retyping. Disputes shrink because the paper trail is complete, and cash comes in faster because invoicing starts the day the job closes.

Beyond ERP: Integrity Data That Compounds

Inspection results captured in Atlantis ERP can flow into Atlantis Digital Twins — corrosion mapping, API 579 fitness-for-service, and API 581 risk-based inspection on a 3D asset model — a compelling capability when bidding integrity contracts to operators. Frequently Asked Questions

Is Atlantis ERP suitable for PETRONAS-licensed vendors?

Yes. It structures the competency, calibration, procedural, and job-record evidence that PETRONAS and operator audits examine, with audit packages generated from live data. Workflows are customizable to your license scope and PTS obligations.

Can it manage both onshore bases and offshore campaigns?

Yes — multi-branch operations across KL, Labuan, Miri, and East Coast bases, with offline field capture for offshore and remote wellsite work that syncs on return to coverage.

Does it handle serialized drill pipe and OCTG inspection?

Yes. Serialized traceability, per-joint inspection results, and certificate generation per DS-1, API, or client specs are core workflows, with full component history retained.

What about accounting, HR, and procurement?

All included — Atlantis ERP is built on 30+ integrated Odoo apps, so finance (including SST handling), HR, purchasing, and inventory share one database with operations.

We keep pricing tailored rather than published: affordable, accessible, and scoped to your users and modules. Request a demo and you receive a tailored quote within 24 hours.
